inputs.name: formula
inputs.value: E[F(T)] = mu L int_0^T F_X(u) du

inputs.name: F_X diffusion series, mean 4 Ne
inputs.cite: standard (Kimura & Ohta 1969 Eq. 15 for the mean; B7b q1)

day.reading: empty start: count = mu L int F_X ~ mu L (T - 4Ne)

critic.reading: exact for the empty start (a point for Day); from a full start the count is mu L T
critic.note: whether the start is empty is M-202 (data-check); pairwise divergence is M-219

notes: The algebra is exact for an empty start and the leading-order rows reproduce. Rows outside T >> 4Ne understate the exact count: Ne = 5e4 gives 2.28M (loss 69.8%, table 79.4%), and the printed 0 at T = 4Ne is 1.52M exact (20% of mu L T). The start state, not this formula, decides between the two counts (M-202).
